say:0:1510746001:0.source_cn: 看来路上的守卫是拦不住他们了。
say:0:1510746001:0.male: Looks like the guards along the path won't be able to stop them.
say:0:1510746001:0.female: Looks like the guards along the path won't be able to stop them.

say:1:1510746002:0.text: We need to get to the shrine.
say:1:1510746002:0.male: We need to get to the shrine.
say:1:1510746002:0.female: We need to get to the shrine.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510702001:.text: Wait, that's an army. Where are they headed?

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510702002:.text: I, Lygos, shall lead the charge!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510702003:.text: We take the fight to those savages in Wrathwood Grove!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1510702003:.source_cn: 讨伐兽人，占领树怒山谷！

say:6:1510703002:0.text: Who knows? Maybe the young Regulus is looking for a quick victory.
say:6:1510703002:0.source_cn: 谁知道呢？可能那位年轻的领主想速战速决？

say:9:1510703003:0.text: Abundius may be the Regulus, but his powers are kept in check by the councilors and various nobles. He can't just do as he pleases.
say:9:1510703003:0.source_cn: 阿邦德虽是领主，但他的命令被议事官与诸多贵族掣肘，各方...

say:10:1510703004:0.text: Especially after the flood. To mobilize an army when people are this unsettled... he'd need an airtight reason to avoid being accused of sending his people to their deaths.
say:10:1510703004:0.source_cn: 尤其是在洪水之后。在人心动荡时出兵，要想不被指控枉顾人...

say:14:1510703005:0.text: This is a huge military procession, but the general isn't with them... Something's very wrong here.
say:14:1510703005:0.source_cn: 军队出征声势浩大，统帅却不在队伍里……这太反常了。

say:15:1510703006:0.text: The Halians are definitely up to something.
say:15:1510703006:0.source_cn: 呼临人一定有别的计谋。

say:16:1510703007:0.text: We need to find him. We can't let the Halians get away with whatever they're planning!
say:16:1510703007:0.source_cn: 得找到他。无论呼临人想做什么，都不能让他们得逞！

say:20:1510703009:0.text: The connection I had with my tracking spear was cut off the moment I entered Halia.
say:20:1510703009:0.source_cn: 来到呼临城以后，我和追踪矛之间的感应就中断了。

say:21:1510703010:0.text: It's quite simple for a god to block your tracking, even if your powers came from the Hunting God.
say:21:1510703010:0.source_cn: 对一位神明来说，想要切断你的追踪并不困难，即便那是狩猎...
say:21:1510703010:0.male: It's quite simple for a god to block your tracking, even if your powers came from the Hunting God.
say:21:1510703010:0.female: It's quite simple for a god to block your tracking, even if your powers came from the Hunting Goddess.

choice:11:1:2.text: The God of Harvest doesn't seem to be here.
choice:11:1:2.male: The God of Harvest doesn't seem to be here.
choice:11:1:2.female: The God of Harvest doesn't seem to be here.

say:25:1510703012:0.text: It takes time to move an army. They need to march to Mirehold first, which is some distance from Halia. The threat to Wrathwood Grove isn't imminent, there's no need to be so worried.
say:25:1510703012:0.source_cn: 行军需要时间，水泽营地距离呼临城尚有一段距离，树怒山谷...

say:26:1510703013:0.text: If it comes down to it, I'll use my teleportation magic to get us back to Wrathwood Grove. We still have some time, so we should investigate why this Halian army is even marching out.
say:26:1510703013:0.source_cn: 必要时，我会用传送魔法带你们立刻返回树怒山谷支援。趁现...

say:27:1510703014:0.text: I have a feeling... the reason is probably linked to the God of Harvest.
say:27:1510703014:0.source_cn: 我有一种预感……他们出征的缘由很可能与丰饶神有关。

narration:29:15010712:0.text: Along the way, you hear that Lygos is preparing to lead his troops against Wrathwood Grove. The people fervently cheer them on as they set out.
narration:29:15010712:0.source_cn: 路上，你们听闻副将隆尔即将领兵攻打树怒山谷，声势浩大，...
narration:29:15010712:0.male: Along the way, you hear that Lygos is preparing to lead his troops against Wrathwood Grove. The people fervently cheer them on as they set out.
narration:29:15010712:0.female: Along the way, you hear that Lygos is preparing to lead his troops against Wrathwood Grove. The people fervently cheer them on as they set out.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510709002:.text: Decem, why haven't you left yet?

say:5:1510710001:0.text: Decem, the general's already left through the north gate. Aren't you heading out with him?
say:5:1510710001:0.source_cn: 哥哥，统帅大人从城北走了，你不跟上他的队伍吗？

say:6:1510710002:0.text: *Sigh*... You wouldn't get it, Junius. Even I get scared sometimes...
say:6:1510710002:0.source_cn: ……唉，你不懂，哥哥也有害怕的事……

say:7:1510710003:0.text: Are... are you really scared? I heard Beti say his dad went off to war and never came back...
say:7:1510710003:0.source_cn: 你……你是害怕吗？我听说贝迪说，他父亲出征后就再也没回来……

say:8:1510710004:0.text: Junius, listen up. I'm going with the general's elite squad... taking the more dangerous route.
say:8:1510710004:0.source_cn: 朱尼，你仔细听我说，统帅这支队伍……路线比较危险。

say:10:1510710006:0.text: What if... you go and never come back...
say:10:1510710006:0.source_cn: 要是……要是去了就再也回不来的话……

say:11:1510710007:0.text: That won't happen... and you're too young to worry about that.
say:11:1510710007:0.source_cn: 不会的……小小年纪，别担心那么多。

say:12:1510710008:0.text: Junius, I gotta go. You... stay safe, okay?
say:12:1510710008:0.source_cn: 朱尼，哥哥该走了。你……你要好好照顾自己，知道吗？

say:18:1510710010:0.text: That coward's off chasing Perseus' squad.
say:18:1510710010:0.source_cn: 那个懦夫要去追珀尔修斯的队伍。

say:19:1510710011:0.text: <style="highlight">Follow him</style> and we'll learn Perseus' route and goals.

say:21:1510710012:0.text: But we can't just ignore the army's main forces, either...
say:21:1510710012:0.source_cn: 隆尔副将带领的主力军队也不能放着不管……

choice_prompt:23:1510710016.text: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.
choice_prompt:23:1510710016.source_cn: 如果出现紧急情况，记得用传讯石联络。但愿此行我们都能顺利。
choice_prompt:23:1510710016.male: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.
choice_prompt:23:1510710016.female: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.

say:27:1510710014:0.text: Alright. You take Gala and Nazrik with you. And be careful.
say:27:1510710014:0.source_cn: 好，你带着加拉和那非一起去，多加小心。
say:27:1510710014:0.male: Alright. You take Gala and Nazrik with you. And be careful.
say:27:1510710014:0.female: Alright. You take Gala and Nazrik with you. And be careful.

say:28:1510710016:0.female: Use the echo stone to contact me if there's an emergency. I want to see all of us come back in one piece.

say:33:1510710015:0.text: Morgan and I will handle things just fine. It's you three that I'm worried about.
say:33:1510710015:0.source_cn: 交给我和摩根吧，你们也多加小心。
say:33:1510710015:0.male: Morgan and I will handle things just fine. It's you three that I'm worried about.
say:33:1510710015:0.female: Morgan and I will handle things just fine. It's you three that I'm worried about.

choice:23:1:2.text: And you deal with the main forces.
choice:23:1:2.source_cn: 大部队那边交给你们了
choice:23:1:2.male: And you deal with the main forces.
choice:23:1:2.female: And you deal with the main forces.

narration:34:15010713:0.text: You come across a lone soldier who seems to have fallen behind Perseus' army out of fear.
narration:34:15010713:0.source_cn: 你们发现一个落单的呼临士兵，似乎因为害怕没跟上珀尔修斯...
narration:34:15010713:0.male: You come across a lone soldier who seems to have fallen behind Perseus' army out of fear.
narration:34:15010713:0.female: You come across a lone soldier who seems to have fallen behind Perseus' army out of fear.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510713001:.text: This shipment only goes to the guard post?

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510713002:.text: Yeah, but the next run goes to the front lines.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510713004:.text: We have to catch up to that soldier!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1510713004:.source_cn: 想办法追上那个士兵，不能跟丢！
cinematic_dialogue:2:1510713004:.male: We have to catch up to that soldier!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1510713004:.female: We have to catch up to that soldier!

say:6:1510714001:0.text: ... The road is blocked by carts.

say:7:1510714002:0.text: I've already marked him with a tracking spear.

say:8:1510714003:0.text: Once these carts clear away, we'll be right back on his tail.
say:8:1510714003:0.source_cn: 马车让开后，立刻就能跟上。

say:9:1510714004:0.text: These carts are loaded with weapons. The Halians really are planning for war...
say:9:1510714004:0.source_cn: 车上装满了武器。呼临人真的要发动大战……

narration:10:1510714005:0.text: After a tense wait, the carts blocking the road finally move.
narration:10:1510714005:0.source_cn: 焦急地等待了好一阵后，拥堵的马车终于离去

narration:13:15010721:0.text: While pursuing the lone soldier, a convoy of supply wagons blocks your path. In the nick of time, Nazrik hurls his tracking spear at the soldier.
narration:13:15010721:0.source_cn: 追踪落单士兵的途中，你们被军备马车挡住去路。紧要关头，...
narration:13:15010721:0.male: While pursuing the lone soldier, a convoy of supply wagons blocks your path. In the nick of time, Nazrik hurls his tracking spear at the soldier.
narration:13:15010721:0.female: While pursuing the lone soldier, a convoy of supply wagons blocks your path. In the nick of time, Nazrik hurls his tracking spear at the soldier.

say:5:1510720001:0.text: That's the <style="highlight">Taothos Rift</style> up ahead. No roads lead off from here… but I don't see any Halians around either.

say:6:1510720002:0.text: That soldier definitely went this way. And it fits his description of a "more dangerous route".
say:6:1510720002:0.source_cn: 那个呼临士兵的确往是这个方向走的。这也符合他说的“危险...

say:7:1510720003:0.text: But we're still inside Halian territory. What if that whole conversation between the brothers was bait for us?
say:7:1510720003:0.source_cn: 但这里是呼临人的领地。他们非常狡猾，或许那对兄弟的所言...

choice_prompt:8:1510720003.text: But we're still inside Halian territory. What if that whole conversation between the brothers was bait for us?
choice_prompt:8:1510720003.source_cn: 但这里是呼临人的领地。他们非常狡猾，或许那对兄弟的所言所行是一个诱饵。

say:9:1510720004:0.text: Doesn't mean it's not a trap.
say:9:1510720004:0.male: Doesn't mean it's not a trap.
say:9:1510720004:0.female: Doesn't mean it's not a trap.

say:10:1510720006:0.text: But... Perseus and his soldiers are gone. Did they cross the rift?
say:10:1510720006:0.source_cn: 但，珀尔修斯和那些士兵不见了。他们度过了深壑？

say:11:1510720007:0.text: We'll have to ask someone who knows.

choice_prompt:12:1510720007.text: We'll have to ask someone who knows.

say:13:1510720008:0.text: That soldier is still around, just hiding. I'll go drag him out.
say:13:1510720008:0.source_cn: 那个士兵还在此地，只是躲藏了。我去将他捉出来。
say:13:1510720008:0.male: That soldier is still around, just hiding. I'll go drag him out.
say:13:1510720008:0.female: That soldier is still around, just hiding. I'll go drag him out.

say:15:1510720010:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll look around for other clues.
say:15:1510720010:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll look around for other clues.
say:15:1510720010:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll look around for other clues.

say:17:1510720009:0.text: Yes. I'll go drag him out.
say:17:1510720009:0.male: Yes. I'll go drag him out.
say:17:1510720009:0.female: Yes. I'll go drag him out.

choice:8:0:1.text: They don't know we overheard them.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 你忘了，我们是偷听到的
choice:8:0:1.male: They don't know we overheard them.
choice:8:0:1.female: They don't know we overheard them.

say:18:1510720005:0.text: It's just a habit of mine.
say:18:1510720005:0.male: It's just a habit of mine.
say:18:1510720005:0.female: It's just a habit of mine.

narration:19:15010723:0.text: You follow the lone soldier all the way to the Taothos Rift. Amid the howling wind, you must figure out how he made it across.
narration:19:15010723:0.source_cn: 你们一路跟踪落单士兵，竟走到了塔欧妥斯深壑。崖风呼啸，...
narration:19:15010723:0.male: You follow the lone soldier all the way to the Taothos Rift. Amid the howling wind, you must figure out how he made it across.
narration:19:15010723:0.female: You follow the lone soldier all the way to the Taothos Rift. Amid the howling wind, you must figure out how he made it across.

cinematic_dialogue:3:1510740001:.text: General Perseus, we can't break through!

cinematic_dialogue:3:1510740002:.text: Damn, they were prepared for us...

cinematic_dialogue:3:1510740003:.text: All units! Fall back! To the Primal Shrine!
cinematic_dialogue:3:1510740003:.source_cn: 都听令！先撤退！去狩猎神殿！

say:5:1510741001:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Perseus ordered his soldiers to attack the <style="highlight">Primal Shrine</style>!
say:5:1510741001:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Perseus ordered his soldiers to attack the <style="highlight">Primal Shrine</style>!
say:5:1510741001:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Perseus ordered his soldiers to attack the <style="highlight">Primal Shrine</style>!

say:7:1510741002:0.text: Ha! This is good news! The entire way from here to the shrine is guarded by our people. They won't get past us easily. We can press our advantage!
say:7:1510741002:0.source_cn: 这是个好消息！从这里到神殿一路上都有我们的守卫，没那么...

choice_prompt:8:1510741002.text: Ha! This is good news! The entire way from here to the shrine is guarded by our people. They won't get past us easily. We can press our advantage!
choice_prompt:8:1510741002.source_cn: 这是个好消息！从这里到神殿一路上都有我们的守卫，没那么容易躲过去，我们正好乘胜追击！

say:9:1510741003:0.text: The Great Herdmaster is going to intervene personally?!
say:9:1510741003:0.source_cn: 伟大的兽群之主要亲自出手？！那我们……
say:9:1510741003:0.male: The Great Herdmaster is going to intervene personally?!
say:9:1510741003:0.female: The Great Herdmaster is going to intervene personally?!

say:10:1510741004:0.text: The Herdmaster has spoken. All you need to do is obey his divine will.
say:10:1510741004:0.source_cn: 兽群之主已经发话，你们只需要遵守神谕。
say:10:1510741004:0.male: The Herdmaster has spoken. All you need to do is obey his divine will.
say:10:1510741004:0.female: The Herdmaster has spoken. All you need to do is obey her divine will.

say:12:1510741005:0.text: The Halians are cunning. Stay on guard in case they have another trick up their sleeve.
say:12:1510741005:0.source_cn: 呼临人狡诈，继续守备，以防后招。

say:13:1510741006:0.text: Understood! May your spears stay ever sharp!
say:13:1510741006:0.source_cn: 是……我们服从！愿你们的矛永远锋利！
say:13:1510741006:0.male: Understood! May your spears stay ever sharp!
say:13:1510741006:0.female: Understood! May your spears stay ever sharp!

choice:8:0:1.text: You stay here and protect Veilwatch Camp.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 你们留下来保护逐影营地
choice:8:0:1.male: You stay here and protect Veilwatch Camp.
choice:8:0:1.female: You stay here and protect Veilwatch Camp.

narration:16:15010738:0.text: After failing to breach the Veilwatch Camp, the Halian soldiers shift their focus to the Primal Shrine. Nazrik throws a tracking spear at Perseus during his retreat.
narration:16:15010738:0.source_cn: 见逐影营地攻略不下，呼临士兵转战狩猎神殿。呼临撤退之际...

cinematic_dialogue:2:1510747001:.text: It's a dead end! General, what do we do?

say:6:1510748002:0.text: I don't need you to tell me that!
say:6:1510748002:0.male: I don't need you to tell me that!
say:6:1510748002:0.female: I don't need you to tell me that!

say:8:1510748003:0.text: You can't escape. This whole area is a marsh.
say:8:1510748003:0.source_cn: 你逃不掉，这一片都是沼泽。

say:9:1510748004:0.text: If you become our prisoner, at least your soldiers will live.
say:9:1510748004:0.source_cn: 成为俘虏，至少你的士兵能保命。

say:10:1510748005:0.text: A marsh? So what? Every single one of my soldiers has survived floods and saved lives.
say:10:1510748005:0.source_cn: 沼泽又如何？我麾下的每一位士兵都曾在洪水中沉浮、救人。

say:11:1510748006:0.text: Do you really think this swamp is more hopeless than the floods that drowned Halia?!
say:11:1510748006:0.source_cn: 眼前这片沼泽，难道会比洪水淹没呼临时更令人绝望吗？！

say:14:1510748008:0.text: The people who died in the storms and the floods? You have no right to speak for them, you bloodthirsty god!
say:14:1510748008:0.source_cn: 谈那些死在暴雨和洪水里的人？你无权替他们发话，嗜血的神明！
say:14:1510748008:0.male: The people who died in the storms and the floods? You have no right to speak for them, you bloodthirsty god!
say:14:1510748008:0.female: The people who died in the storms and the floods? You have no right to speak for them, you bloodthirsty goddess!

say:16:1510748009:0.source_cn: 但是，很多雅库伯尔人也死了！

say:17:1510748010:0.text: Halia started this war. The Wildborn never invaded your lands.
say:17:1510748010:0.source_cn: 是呼临先发动的战争。雅库伯尔没有侵犯你们的领地。

say:18:1510748011:0.text: The Wildborn who died... were innocent.
say:18:1510748011:0.source_cn: 死去的雅库伯尔人……无辜。

say:20:1510748013:0.text: I won't be fooled by you again. I've already paid for that lesson with blood.
say:20:1510748013:0.source_cn: 我不会再一次上你们的当，我已为此付出了血的教训。

say:22:1510748014:0.text: I've seen you for who you truly are. No, I should have seen it long before the war even started...
say:22:1510748014:0.source_cn: 狩猎神……我已经认清了你的真面目。不，远在战争开始前，...
say:22:1510748014:0.male: I've seen you for who you truly are. No, I should have seen it long before the war even started...
say:22:1510748014:0.female: I've seen you for who you truly are. No, I should have seen it long before the war even started...

choice:5:1:2.text: I came to negotiate in good faith.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我是诚心来和你谈判的
choice:5:1:2.male: I came to negotiate in good faith.
choice:5:1:2.female: I came to negotiate in good faith.

choice_prompt:24:1510748016.text: You mean the golden gift you brought when you descended... You're going to bestow it upon the Halians?!
choice_prompt:24:1510748016.source_cn: 您说的是您降临时带来的金黄恩赐……您要将它恩赐给呼临人？！
choice_prompt:24:1510748016.male: You mean the golden gift you brought when you descended... You're going to bestow it upon the Halians?!
choice_prompt:24:1510748016.female: You mean the golden gift you brought when you descended... You're going to bestow it upon the Halians?!

say:26:1510748016:0.text: You mean the golden gift you brought when you descended... You're going to bestow it upon the Halians?!
say:26:1510748016:0.source_cn: 您说的是您降临时带来的金黄恩赐……您要将它恩赐给呼临人？！
say:26:1510748016:0.male: You mean the golden gift you brought when you descended... You're going to bestow it upon the Halians?!
say:26:1510748016:0.female: You mean the golden gift you brought when you descended... You're going to bestow it upon the Halians?!

say:29:1510748018:0.text: Hunting God, you are an enemy of Halia.
say:29:1510748018:0.source_cn: 狩猎神，你是呼临的敌人。
say:29:1510748018:0.male: Hunting God, you are an enemy of Halia.
say:29:1510748018:0.female: Hunting Goddess, you are an enemy of Halia.

say:30:1510748019:0.text: By the supreme decree of Sarethiel, the God of Harvest... I will conquer the lands under your charge! And you will know the agony of watching water turn to blood, and watching it drown everyone you love!
say:30:1510748019:0.source_cn: 奉丰饶神赛图恩的至高神谕……我将征服你所庇佑的家园！让...
say:30:1510748019:0.male: By the supreme decree of Sarethiel, the God of Harvest... I will conquer the lands under your charge! And you will know the agony of watching water turn to blood, and watching it drown everyone you love!
say:30:1510748019:0.female: By the supreme decree of Sarethiel, the God of Harvest... I will conquer the lands under your charge! And you will know the agony of watching water turn to blood, and watching it drown everyone you love!

choice:24:0:1.text: I have a stalk of wheat that can bear grain.
choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 我有一支可以结穗的麦子
choice:24:0:1.male: I have a stalk of wheat that can bear grain.
choice:24:0:1.female: I have a stalk of wheat that can bear grain.

choice:5:2:3.text: I can help you survive the famine.
choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 我有办法帮你们度过饥荒
choice:5:2:3.male: I can help you survive the famine.
choice:5:2:3.female: I can help you survive the famine.

say:31:1510748020:0.text: For a god, you ask some ridiculous questions.
say:31:1510748020:0.source_cn: 你身为神明，居然会问出这种可笑的问题。
say:31:1510748020:0.male: For a god, you ask some ridiculous questions.
say:31:1510748020:0.female: For a goddess, you ask some ridiculous questions.

say:32:1510748021:0.text: If you really want to know, why don't you ask the Wildborn behind you why they revere and worship you, why they'd willingly give their lives for you... and even be proud of it!
say:32:1510748021:0.source_cn: 若你真想知道，不如问问你身后的雅库伯尔人，为什么这般尊...
say:32:1510748021:0.male: If you really want to know, why don't you ask the Wildborn behind you why they revere and worship you, why they'd willingly give their lives for you... and even be proud of it!
say:32:1510748021:0.female: If you really want to know, why don't you ask the Wildborn behind you why they revere and worship you, why they'd willingly give their lives for you... and even be proud of it!

say:33:1510748022:0.text: Look at your shrine. So grand, so magnificent... and so close.
say:33:1510748022:0.source_cn: 看看你的神殿，多么宏伟高大……又近在咫尺。
say:33:1510748022:0.male: Look at your shrine. So grand, so magnificent... and so close.
say:33:1510748022:0.female: Look at your shrine. So grand, so magnificent... and so close.

say:34:1510748023:0.text: How many Wildborn have broken their backs and spent their lives to build it?!
say:34:1510748023:0.source_cn: 为了修葺它，多少雅库伯尔人磨破脊背，耗尽了人生！
say:34:1510748023:0.male: How many Wildborn have broken their backs and spent their lives to build it?!
say:34:1510748023:0.female: How many Wildborn have broken their backs and spent their lives to build it?!

say:35:1510748024:0.text: Countless followers died for your cruel amusement long before the Halians and Wildborn ever went to war.
say:35:1510748024:0.source_cn: 在呼临与雅库伯尔交战之前，已经有无数信徒为你酷厉的乐趣...
say:35:1510748024:0.male: Countless followers died for your cruel amusement long before the Halians and Wildborn ever went to war.
say:35:1510748024:0.female: Countless followers died for your cruel amusement long before the Halians and Wildborn ever went to war.

say:36:1510748025:0.text: Gorgonna sacrificed herself for you, then the Wildborn offered up Gala, but you still weren't satisfied! You went to Halia to reap the lives of the innocent!
say:36:1510748025:0.source_cn: 露为你牺牲，雅库伯尔又献上加拉为祭，而你仍不餍足，又去...
say:36:1510748025:0.male: Gorgonna sacrificed herself for you, then the Wildborn offered up Gala, but you still weren't satisfied! You went to Halia to reap the lives of the innocent!
say:36:1510748025:0.female: Gorgonna sacrificed herself for you, then the Wildborn offered up Gala, but you still weren't satisfied! You went to Halia to reap the lives of the innocent!

say:38:1510748027:0.text: I will destroy your shrine and shatter the faith they have in you. I will make you see...
say:38:1510748027:0.source_cn: 我要击毁你的神殿，踏碎对你的信仰，让你知道——
say:38:1510748027:0.male: I will destroy your shrine and shatter the faith they have in you. I will make you see...
say:38:1510748027:0.female: I will destroy your shrine and shatter the faith they have in you. I will make you see...

say:39:1510748028:1.text: ... that we are not your playthings!
say:39:1510748028:1.source_cn: 我们——绝不是你掌中的玩物！
say:39:1510748028:1.male: ... that we are not your playthings!
say:39:1510748028:1.female: ... that we are not your playthings!

choice:5:3:4.text: Was this all because the God of Harvest ordered it?
choice:5:3:4.source_cn: 这一切都是因为丰饶神的命令？
choice:5:3:4.male: Was this all because the God of Harvest ordered it?
choice:5:3:4.female: Was this all because the God of Harvest ordered it?

narration:41:15010741:0.text: At last, you corner Perseus and his troops on a cliff's edge. He assumes a battle stance, ready to fight you to his last breath.
narration:41:15010741:0.source_cn: 你们追击珀尔修斯，终于将他们逼停在一处高台上。珀尔修斯...
narration:41:15010741:0.male: At last, you corner Perseus and his troops on a cliff's edge. He assumes a battle stance, ready to fight you to his last breath.
narration:41:15010741:0.female: At last, you corner Perseus and his troops on a cliff's edge. He assumes a battle stance, ready to fight you to his last breath.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510736001:.text: Send the Halians to their graves!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510738002:.text: Over my dead body, you grass-munchers!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510801002:.text: What are you doing back here?

cinematic_dialogue:1:1510801003:.text: Explanations can wait—Gala needs help, now!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510801003:.male: Explanations can wait—Gala needs help, now!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1510801003:.female: Explanations can wait—Gala needs help, now!

cinematic_summary:1.text: The true Hunting Goddess emerged. Instead of reprimanding Perseus for disturbing her, she directed her hostility at you.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 真正的狩猎神现身，却没有对惊扰自己的珀尔修斯多加责问，反而将敌对的矛头瞄准了你。

subtitle:1:1511090004:.text: And a sinner who dared impersonate a god!
subtitle:1:1511090004:.male: And a sinner who dared impersonate a god!
subtitle:1:1511090004:.female: And a sinner who dared impersonate a god!

cinematic_summary:1.text: In the face of the goddess' wrath, Gala took the blow for you and was gravely wounded. You teleported both Gala and Nazrik to safety.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 面对狩猎神的怒火，加拉毫不犹豫地选择了保护你，甚至因此重伤昏迷。危急关头，你只能用传送魔法带加拉和那非先行离开。
